mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for financial services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO primarily aims to rank your website high on search engine results pages (SERPs), often requiring a click to your site. AEO, however, focuses on providing concise, direct answers within the search results themselves, including featured snippets, knowledge panels, and voice search responses. For financial advisors, this means your expertise is immediately accessible to users looking for quick solutions, often before they even visit your website, establishing trust and authority upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO delivers direct answers within search results, unlike traditional SEO which focuses on website rankings. It positions financial advisors as immediate sources of information.
